text: The system should support user authentication.
The application must be responsive and work on multiple devices.
Users should be able to reset their passwords.
The system should provide real-time notifications.
The application must support data encryption for sensitive information.
Users should have different permission levels (e.g., admin, regular user).
The system should generate reports based on user activities.
The application must be compatible with major web browsers.
The system should have a backup and recovery mechanism.
Users should be able to customize their profile settings.
